ITEM 1 | Yellow-gold cubes with a slightly glossy, moist surface and a fibrous grain, about 2 cm per side, clustered in the upper right of the plate in a loose heap roughly 2 cm high | 55
ITEM 2 | Bright red, glossy hulled pieces with pale whitish cores, whole and halved, about 2 to 3 cm, scattered across the middle and right of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Small clusters of deep red, bumpy, soft drupelets with a matte, slightly damp look, about 1 to 1.5 cm each, mounded in the center of the plate | 40
ITEM 4 | Small, dark blue to purple spheres with a slight dusty sheen, about 1.5 cm in diameter, scattered singly among the red pieces | 18
ITEM 5 | Cube-shaped pieces with bright pink-red flesh, slightly juicy edges, a paler white rind-like border, and a small pale center spot, about 2.5 cm per side, lying flat in the lower left and left side of the plate | 60
ITEM 6 | A single small pale pink wedge with a rounded, moist surface, about 2 cm across and 1 cm high, sitting near the upper left center of the plate | 10
